Please take one look at **http://maker:4001**:

**Save a link and press Add.** You'll now see a **preview picture** at the top of the review panel (and it stays on the saved card). Add a title and description, save it, and see how the card looks with the image banner.

Two things to check:

- **Does the preview image on the card feel right** — the right size and position, adding useful recognition without crowding the calm layout? (The colourful banner is a stand-in; the real app would show the page's actual preview picture.)
- **When a page simply has no preview image**, the card falls back to exactly the text-only card you already approved earlier. **Is that graceful "just leave it off" fallback what you'd want**, rather than showing a placeholder box?

If those land well, I'm confident the whole saving experience matches your intent, and I'll consider this flow settled.
